text: Additional FILETOSTR directory/access-denied boundary added to #6542: VFP9 COM raises 1705; Linux Copperfin catches generic runtime resource fault 1003 exposing std::filebuf read diagnostic. Empty ordinary file is valid. Evidence: https://github.com/rhamenator/Project-Copperfin/issues/6542#issuecomment-5822590702 . Windows Copperfin path not tested; #6543 remains separate mid-read lock case.
